name: Hume Audio Decision API
desc: One API that answers any question you ask about an audio clip
desc_zh: 对一段音频提问就能得到答案的 API
solves: Call scoring needs a pipeline per rubric. You send the questions and the clip, and get probabilities back.
solves_zh: 每套评分标准都要搭一条流水线。把问题和音频一起发过去，拿回来的是概率。
best_for: You must score two hundred support calls against one checklist tonight.
best_for_zh: 今晚要按同一张检查表给两百通客服录音打分。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://hume.ai/blog (Hume's blog, 'Introducing Hume's Audio Decision API' e）。 Distinct from the ledger's 'Hume AI' empathic-voice entry (2024-06-19): this is an audio-native decision model that answers questions about a clip instead of synthesising speech.
